_comment: Localized string slots of FNIRSI 2D15P V2.7.0.7 (stock crc32 B43E8C2D), MCU addresses (file = addr - 0x11000). Language byte 0x20000198+0xE28: 1 = secondary (stock: Chinese), 2 = English. Derived by static analysis 2026-10-06, see notes/hardware.md "Language/string system". kind: rom_table/code_pool_pair = 32-bit pointer word at *_site.at (repointable); code_cmp_pair = movw/t (repointable) or pc-relative addw (in-place only, capacity incl NUL); rw_data_table = pointer in compressed RW image (in-place only).
